== Notes ==
* The triggering damage is calculated before [[damage reduction]], so a [[55 Monk]] enchanted with [[Protective Spirit]] and Judge's Intervention could be dealt 60 [[damage]], have that reduced to 5 damage, and still trigger Judge's Intervention.

* Combines well with minions, but will not trigger if they die due to their natural [[health degeneration]].
* This skill can cause the highest [[armor-ignoring damage]] in one [[packet]] amongst all player-useable skills; however, [[Grenth's Balance]] can potentially cause a foe to [[Health loss|lose more health]].
{{anomaly|Unlike most other monk spells, Judge's Intervention does not invoke an animation upon the target.}}
{{Outdated info|}}
;[[Feedback:Game updates/20190205|February 05, 2019 update]]; please verify changes to [[Hero behavior|AI behavior]].
* [[Hero]]es will use it on allies who have low [[health]] and are not in combat, such as [[minion]]s when travelling between [[mob]]s.
